name: Market fruit
summary: Market fruit is pineapple peeled on the boat, and the sacks the wholesale boats trade. Vietnam Tourism’s towns page names pomelos, pineapples, and durians. The dining chapter names rambutan, jackfruit, and mangosteen in the delta chapter that uses Can Tho as a base. The department advice page adds Phong Điền honey orange, dâu Hạ Châu, red-fleshed jackfruit, seedless durian, and Phong Điền cacao.
origin: Cái Răng boats, Phong Điền gardens, and Cồn Sơn. Fruit months on Vietnam Tourism’s place page are June to August.
howToEat: Cut on the boat, or in a garden at Mỹ Khánh and Cồn Sơn.
seoTitle: Fruit on the Can Tho boats
seoDescription: Pineapple on the Cái Răng boats, plus pomelo, durian, rambutan, jackfruit, mangosteen, and the Phong Điền fruit the department names.
